start: Active workout, a barbell exercise logged by weight and reps, 100 kg on the working set, MettleUp Plus on (or free Plus from the gym), kg, standard 20 kg bar and plates

steps.action: Tap the exercise card's more button
user_sees: A sheet with rows including 'Add warm-up sets' and 'Plate calculator'
must_not: 'Plate calculator' shown on a dumbbell or machine exercise

steps.action: Tap 'Plate calculator'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Plate calculator'
'Target' box holding 100
'Bar' chips with the 20 kg bar picked
'PER SIDE' with the plates 25 and 15
'100 kg · each side loaded the same'
'Using a 20 kg bar (your usual).'
must_not: A target box that is empty when the set has a weight
Different plates for the two sides

steps.action: Change the target to 101
user_sees: 'Can't make 101 kg with your plates. Shown: 100 kg.' followed by a 'Next up: … kg (… a side).' line
must_not: A plate size the member switched off in Plates and bars
A load shown as exact when it is not

start: Active workout, barbell exercise, 100 kg on the working set, standard 20 kg bar

steps.action: Tap the card's more button, then 'Add warm-up sets'
user_sees: Warm-up rows added before the working sets: 40 kg x 5, 60 kg x 5, 80 kg x 3, each marked as a warm-up
must_not: A warm-up lighter than the empty bar
A warm-up at or above the working weight
Two warm-ups with the same weight one after the other

start: Plate calculator open from a barbell exercise

steps.action: Tap the 'Change plates and bars' button under 'Using a 20 kg bar (your usual).'
user_sees: The Plates and bars page opens
If it cannot open: 'Couldn't open Plates and bars. Try again from Settings → Plates and bars.'
must_not: The calculator closing with nothing opened and no message

steps.action: Switch off the 25 kg plate, come back, open 'Plate calculator' again on 100 kg
user_sees: Plates per side made without any 25 kg plate
must_not: A 25 kg plate still in the answer

start: Active workout, barbell exercise, no weight typed on any working set

steps.action: Tap the card's more button, then 'Add warm-up sets'
user_sees: Message 'Set a working weight first' with 'Enter a weight on a working set, then add warm-up sets.'
must_not: Warm-up rows added at 0 kg
Warm-ups worked out from last time's weight without saying so

start: Active workout, barbell exercise, member with no MettleUp Plus and no free Plus from a gym

steps.action: Tap the card's more button, then 'Plate calculator'
user_sees: The sheet closes and a locked explanation for the calculators shows, with a way to MettleUp Plus
must_not: The plate calculator opening for free
A blank sheet

steps.action: Open the calculator as a Plus member and type 15 as the target
user_sees: 'Just the bar — no plates needed.'
'The bar alone is 20 kg (target 15 kg)'
must_not: Minus plates
An error

start: Plates and bars set up with a 15 kg bar added; calculator open on 60 kg

steps.action: Tap the 15 kg bar chip
user_sees: Plates per side worked out again for a 15 kg bar
'Using a 15 kg bar.' without '(your usual)'
must_not: The old 20 kg bar plates still shown

steps.action: Close the calculator, remove the 15 kg bar in Plates and bars, open the calculator again
user_sees: Only the remaining bars as chips; the usual bar picked
must_not: A chip for the removed bar
A crash on a bar that no longer exists

start: Member of a gym whose membership is active (free Plus from the gym), no own Plus; barbell exercise

steps.action: Tap the card's more button, then 'Plate calculator'
user_sees: The calculator opens like for a Plus member
must_not: The locked explanation while the gym plan is active

steps.action: After the gym plan ends, do it again
user_sees: The locked explanation for the calculators
must_not: The calculator still open for free after the gym plan ended
The plate setup sent to the gym or the server
